required_shims.reason: The NT4 plugin still falls back from /var/lib/helios/nt4.json to /etc/helios/nt4.json while persisted device settings finish migrating.
required_shims.replace_with: Read NT4 settings only from /var/lib/helios/nt4.json after all deployed images migrate the file forward.

required_shims.reason: The NT4 plugin still falls back from /var/lib/helios/team to /etc/helios/team while persisted team-number migration remains incomplete.
required_shims.replace_with: Resolve the team number only from /var/lib/helios/team once all startup/device-setting writers populate it.

required_shims.reason: HTTP persisted settings still mirror reads and writes into /etc/helios for backward compatibility with older runtime paths.
required_shims.replace_with: Delete mirrored /etc/helios storage once all runtime readers and OTA images only use /var/lib/helios.

required_shims.reason: The NT4 device API still exposes a legacy /etc/helios fallback while settings migration completes.
required_shims.replace_with: Persist and load NT4 settings exclusively from the data-root path after the migration window closes.

required_shims.reason: File-backed streams still sanitize the legacy media-file identity token so old persisted manifests remain startable.
required_shims.replace_with: Drop media-file token coercion after persisted file-stream manifests have been migrated to stable alias and hardware-id fields.

required_shims.reason: Media replay still guesses calibration from the only live/persisted calibrated camera when old media lacks stream-id metadata.
required_shims.replace_with: Require replay metadata to carry source stream identity and stop guessing calibration from unrelated cameras.

required_shims.reason: Replay still remuxes raw annex-b H264/H265 captures into MP4 as a compatibility bridge for older/offboard media archives.
required_shims.replace_with: Standardize replay inputs on supported containerized media and remove the on-demand remux cache.

required_shims.reason: helios-api still falls back to a temp data root when persistent partitions are unavailable during bring-up or tests.
required_shims.replace_with: Require a mounted persistent data root outside of explicit test overrides and fail startup instead of silently degrading to tmp.

required_shims.reason: The NT4 bridge still falls back to /etc/helios/team while older images may not populate the data-root team file.
required_shims.replace_with: Resolve the NT4 bridge target host only from /var/lib/helios/team once the team-file migration is complete.

required_shims.reason: Limelight emulation still falls back to /etc/helios/team while older images may not populate the data-root team file.
required_shims.replace_with: Resolve the Limelight adapter target host only from /var/lib/helios/team once the team-file migration is complete.
